# Loading in Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Loading in Data
```{r}
setwd('/Users/lawrencehuynh/PSTAT 197A/PSTAT174-Module0-Class-Survey-Team7')

# loading in data
(background <- 
  read.csv('data/background-clean.csv'))

(interest <- 
  read.csv('data/interest-clean.csv'))

# joint data from Nic 
joint <- background %>%
  inner_join(interest, by = "response_id") %>%
  mutate(
    num_areas = str_count(areas, ",") + 1L
  )

# getting count of specific courses
course_count <- joint %>%
  # separating courses by comma 
  separate_rows(courses, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  
  # creating clean course column 
  mutate(courses = trimws(courses)) %>%
  
  # drop empty string 
  filter(courses != "") %>%
  
  # counting amount of time a course appears 
  count(courses, name = "n") 

# mandatory courses
mandatory <- c("PSTAT 120", "CS 9", "PSTAT 122", "PSTAT 126")

# splitting count by mandatory and non-mandatory courses
(mandatory_course_count <- course_count %>%
  filter(courses %in% mandatory)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

(non_mandatory_course_count <- course_count %>%
  filter(!courses %in% mandatory)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))


```

# EDA

```{r}
# bar plot of Number of Areas of interest
ggplot(joint, aes(x = num_areas)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#003660", col = "#FEBC11") +
  labs(x = "Number of Areas of Interest", y = "Number of People Interested in X Areas") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 13, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 2))

# pie chart of non-mandatory classes 
ggplot(non_mandatory_course_count, aes(x= "", y = n, fill = courses)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Pie Chart of Non-Mandatory Classes") +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.3, label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y")+
  theme_void()

# pie chart of mandatory classes 
ggplot(mandatory_course_count, aes(x= "", y = n, fill = courses)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Pie Chart of Mandatory Classes") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void()
```
